meta.note: The theme.css tokens: cool slate neutrals (not pure zinc), one restrained accent, a hue per pipeline phase, Geist, a 13px UI base. Icons and the castle mark are copied verbatim from icons.tsx.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The app frame: title bar, the one sidebar, the status line. Everything else sits on `surface` inside it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The main content panel, inset in the canvas with a `border` hairline and `radius-lg`. Page bodies, lists, documents.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, popovers, the command palette, dialogs, toasts. Pair with `shadow-popover`.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: A hovered row, menu item or ghost button, on `surface`, `canvas` or `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The current row in a list or the sidebar; a pressed ghost button. Never used for decoration.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Code blocks, terminal output, the transcript, read-only command lines. Sits inside `surface`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The one hairline: the content panel's edge, section dividers, card and input borders. 1px, always.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows of a list, where `border` would draw a grid.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered input or secondary-button border; the Kbd outline. Below 3:1 by design — a control is also told by its label, placeholder and `surface-inset` ground, never by its border alone.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, row labels, body copy. On every surface and on `canvas`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, secondary labels, inactive nav items. On every surface and on `canvas`.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata: timestamps, counts, branch names, property keys, section labels. On every surface and on `canvas` (4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and placeholder glyphs only. Fails 4.5:1 on purpose — never carries information.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default stroke for 16px icons beside labels, on every surface. Hover and active icons take `text`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button per view (inverted neutral, the Cursor/Vercel idiom). Not an accent: color is spent elsewhere.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent: focus ring, the selection bar in lists, links, live/in-progress marks, the review phase. Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-colored words on `surface`, `canvas` and `accent-subtle`.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground for a selected checkbox row or an info notice; its text is `accent-text` or `text`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Shipped, passed, healthy. Icons and dots on any surface; text only beside an icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, in progress (tickets, implementation), partial checks. Icons, dots and short labels.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, destructive, error. Text on every surface; a danger button's label.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground behind an inline error notice, with `danger` or `text` on it.

tokens.name: phase-draft
tokens.usage: Draft glyph (dashed circle). Shape, not hue, tells it apart.

tokens.name: phase-ideation
tokens.usage: Ideation glyph (empty ring), pink. Pipeline hues run pink → teal → amber → orange → blue → green.

tokens.name: phase-spec
tokens.usage: Spec and planning glyph (quarter-filled), teal.

tokens.name: phase-tickets
tokens.usage: Tickets glyph (half-filled), amber.

tokens.name: phase-implementation
tokens.usage: Implementation / building glyph (three-quarter), orange.

tokens.name: phase-review
tokens.usage: Review glyph (ring with a centre dot), blue. The stepper's current step also takes a 14% wash of its phase hue.

tokens.name: phase-shipped
tokens.usage: Shipped glyph (filled circle with a check).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline at 2px offset on every interactive element; 3:1 or better on every surface.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title of a feature or the project home. One per view.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section heading inside a page; dialog title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The branch is merged and the pipeline is complete.
styles.usage: Prose: specs, descriptions, chat messages, markdown.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Auto-continue burns after provider limit reset
styles.usage: The UI default: rows, nav items, inputs, menu items.

styles.name: ui-medium
styles.usage: Button labels, the selected nav item, property values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a row, timestamps, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sidebar group headings and section labels. Sentence case — never uppercase-tracked.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Branch names, paths, commands, hashes — only real code-shaped strings. Never labels or status.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a button or chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in rows; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; gap between property rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and menu padding; sidebar inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding in the content panel.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding above a page title; space around an empty state.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Separation between major page regions on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kbd, checkbox, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rows, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The content panel, cards, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and status dots only. No pill buttons or pill chips.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command palette. Content never takes a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the settings sheet.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the shell and controls are built on.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and icon buttons inside rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The one primary action of a page header; the search field.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Sidebar and list row height (single line).

tokens.name: titlebar-h
tokens.usage: Title bar / page header height.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: The one sidebar. Collapsible to 0; never two at once.

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: A right panel, opened on demand over or beside the content, replacing — not adding to — other panels.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Reading width for page bodies and documents.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small buttons and metadata lines.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size, beside `ui` text.
